'''Izumo Taisha Matsuyama Branch Shrine''' (出雲大社松山分祠, Izumo Ōyashiro Matsuyama Bunshi) is a {{ill|Shinto shrine|abstract|Q845945|ar|جينجا|arz|ضريح شنتو|bcl|Shinto shrine|ca|Jinja|cs|Šintoistická svatyně|da|Shinto-tempel|de|Shintō-Schrein|el|Σιντοϊστικό Ιερό|eo|Ŝintoa sanktejo|es|Jinja|eu|Jinja|fa|معبد شینتویی|fi|Šintolainen pyhäkkö|fr|Sanctuaire shinto|hi|शिंतो मंदिर|hr|Šintoistički hram|hu|Sintó szentély|id|Jinja|it|Jinja|ja|神社|ka|ძინძია|ko|신사 (신토)|lb|Shintō-Schräin|mr|शिंतो मंदिर|nl|Jinja (heiligdom)|no|Jinja|or|ଜିଞ୍ଜା|pl|Jinja|pt|Templo xintoísta|ru|Дзиндзя|sc|Jinja|simple|Shinto shrine|sl|Šintoistično svetišče|sr|Шинтоистички храм|sv|Jinja|th|ศาลเจ้าชินโต|tok|tomo sewi pi nasin sewi Sinto|tr|Şinto tapınağı|uk|Святилище (синто)|uz|Dzindzya|vi|Thần xã|wuu|神社|zh|神社|zh_yue|神社|qid=Q845945|lt=Shinto shrine}} located in Honmachi, [[:en:Matsuyama City|Matsuyama City]], {{ill|Ehime Prefecture|en|Ehime Prefecture|qid=Q123376|lt=Ehime Prefecture}}. It serves as a branch of [[Izumo-taisha|Izumo Taisha]] in [[Izumo City]], {{ill|Shimane Prefecture|en|Shimane Prefecture|qid=Q132751|lt=Shimane Prefecture}}.

== Enshrined deity ==
* [[Ōkuninushi]] (Ōkuninushi-no-Ōkami)

== annual Events ==
* [[Setsubun]] Yakuyoke (*Disaster Prevention*) festival

== Other Information ==
* The Matsuyama Branch Shrine is located directly south of the main Izumo Taisha.
* Ōkuninushi-no-Ōkami is associated with [[Daikokuten]], one of the [[Seven Lucky Gods]], and the shrine is part of the [[Iyo Seven Lucky Gods Pilgrimage]] as the location of Daikokuten.

== Access ==
* Accessible via the [[:en:Iyo Railway|Iyo Railway]] streetcar. Alight at the [[Honmachi Yonchōme Station]].
